title: Teach the Way It Thinks: Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2605.27354v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data engineering for large language model (LLM) reinforcement learning (RL) decides which samples to train on, when to present them, and which to batch together. Existing methods mostly rely on external feedback, such as pass rates or difficulty labels, which observes only the outcome on each sample. We argue that model internals offer richer and more model-intrinsic feedback that can guide all three decisions. We propose SAERL which organizes RL training data in the feature space of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), a mechanistic interpretability tool that decomposes model internals into sparse, interpretable features. SAE features let us view the model as a set of functional regions, each formed by features that related samples activate together. For each sample, its SAE activations indicate which regions it engages, and its gradients projected onto SAE features indicate how training on it would change these regions. Guided by this

translated_title: 按其思考方式施教：用稀疏自编码器引导大语言模型后训练数据工程
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）的数据工程决定了训练哪些样本、何时呈现这些样本，以及哪些样本应一起分批。现有方法大多依赖外部反馈，例如通过率或难度标签，这只能观察到每个样本上的结果。我们认为，模型内部提供了更丰富、更贴近模型自身的反馈，能够指导上述全部三项决策。我们提出SAERL，它在稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征空间中组织强化学习训练数据。SAE是一种机制可解释性工具，可将模型内部分解为稀疏且可解释的特征。借助SAE特征，我们可以将模型视为一组功能区域，每个区域由相关样本共同激活的特征所构成。对于每个样本，其SAE激活表明它参与了哪些区域，而其投影到SAE特征上的梯度则表明对它进行训练将如何改变这些区域。在此指导下……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SAERL方法，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将模型内部分解为稀疏可解释的特征，从模型内部视角（激活与梯度投影）来组织强化学习训练数据，从而决定训练哪些样本、何时呈现以及如何分批，突破了传统仅依赖通过率等外部反馈的数据工程方式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAERL, which organizes RL training data in the feature space of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), using model-internal signals—SAE activations and gradients projected onto interpretable features—to decide which samples to train on, when to present them, and how to batch them, moving beyond external feedback such as pass rates.
